invuselineid.title: Usage Line
invuselineid.remarks: The usage line identifier, which is used to relate an inventory usage line to a completed transaction.

lotnum.title: Lot
lotnum.remarks: Lot number for lotted items. The work order must be approved before you can insert or edit a value. This field is read-only if you have entered a rotating item in the Item field; otherwise, you can modify this field for a lotted item until the record is saved. Click the Detail button to display the Select Lot page.

memo.title: Memo
memo.remarks: Brief remark about the issue transaction.

actualdate.title: Actual Date
actualdate.remarks: Date and time of the issue transaction, which may be different than the time the transaction is recorded in Maximo. Maximo populates the current date and time by default. You can modify the value in this field. Click the Select Date and Time button to use the calendar control.

rollup.title: Rolled Up
rollup.remarks: Indicates whether this transaction has been rolled up.

rotassetnum.title: Rotating Asset
rotassetnum.remarks: Identifies the rotating asset number associated with the item being issued.

taskid.title: Task
taskid.remarks: Task associated with the item being issued. Click the Select Value button to choose a task.

enteredastask.title: Entered as Task
enteredastask.remarks: Was this transaction created against a work order task?

linecost.title: Line Cost
linecost.remarks: Line cost of the transaction, calculated as Unit Cost multiplied by the Quantity of the item.

issueto.title: Issued To
issueto.remarks: Person to whom the item, tool, or material is issued. Click the Detail Menu button to choose a person or go to the People application.

actualstaskid.title: Task
actualstaskid.remarks: Identifies the task for which the item or material was used.

binnum.title: Bin
binnum.remarks: Item's bin number from a storeroom location. The work order must be approved before you can insert or edit a value. This field is read-only if there is a rotating item in the Item field. Otherwise, you can modify this field until the record is saved.

enterby.title: Entered By
enterby.remarks: Maximo user name of the person initiating this transaction.

mrlinenum.title: Requisition Line
mrlinenum.remarks: Line number on the requestion for the item being issued.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Asset number associated with this transaction.

consignment.title: Consignment
consignment.remarks: Indicates whether the transaction was created for a consignment item. This field also indicates that the consignment transaction is included in the consignment invoice, which is sent to the vendor that supplies the inventory item.

conditioncode.title: Condition Code
conditioncode.remarks: Condition code that reflects the current physical condition of the item being issued. Click the Select Value button to choose a condition code.

qtyrequested.title: Requested Quantity
qtyrequested.remarks: The quantity requested for the issue.

actualcost.title: Actual Cost
actualcost.remarks: Price of the item per unit. If you are entering a new special order or direct issue item you can edit this field until the work order is in the status specified in the Work Plan Edit Options window in Multisite Setup.

glcreditacct.title: GL Credit Account
glcreditacct.remarks: GL account to credit the cost of the item. The default value comes from the inventory control account. See the Maximo Finance Manager's Guide for more information. If the work order is approved, click the Detail button to view the GL Account Navigator page. You can modify this field until you save the record.

wonum.title: Work Order
wonum.remarks: Work order to which you want the item issued. Click the Detail Menu button to choose a work order, view work order by classification, or go to the Work Order Tracking application.

issuetype.title: Transaction Type
issuetype.remarks: Type of transaction, either ISSUE or RETURN. Click the Select Value button to choose a transaction type.

issueid.title: Issue Id
issueid.remarks: The ID of the Material Issue record this return is referring to.

porevisionnum.title: PO Revision
porevisionnum.remarks: Revision number of the purchase order. Indicates how many times a purchase order has been revised.

sparepartadded.title: Spare Part Added
sparepartadded.remarks: Indicates that the item was added to the spare parts list for the asset.

wpitemid.title: WPITEMID
wpitemid.remarks: The ID for the WPMaterial that is associated with this InvUseLine

consinvoicenum.title: Consignment Invoice
consinvoicenum.remarks: The number that identifies the invoice that was created to pay for the inventory usage.

itemnum.title: Item
itemnum.remarks: Identifier of the item. The work order must be approved before you can insert a value. There are several ways to enter an item in this field: see the topic Work Actuals - Materials for more information. If you insert a rotating item in the Item field, you must enter rotating equipment in the Rotating Equipment field. You can modify this field until the record is saved.

outside.title: Outside
outside.remarks: Specifies whether the item being issued is a consignment good. If the check box is selected, the item belongs to a contractor (or vendor), but it is stored on-site, and it is an item for which you expect to be charged for its use. If the check box is cleared (the default), the item is not owned by an outside party.

itemsetid.title: Item Set
itemsetid.remarks: Item set identifier for this item.

qtyreturned.title: Quantity Returned
qtyreturned.remarks: Qty returned for this issue-type ISSUE

unitcost.title: Unit Cost
unitcost.remarks: Price of the item which Maximo copies from the Inventory table. The work order must be approved before you can insert or edit a value. This field is read-only if you have entered a rotating item in the Item field. Otherwise, you can modify the field until the record is saved; Maximo then updates the Actual Material Cost field on the Costs tab and the Actual Cost column of the Inventory Transactions table. The original unit cost from the item's inventory record is copied to the Unit Cost column of the Inventory Transactions table.

linetype.title: Line Type
linetype.remarks: Identifies the line type, for example, ITEM, TOOL, or MATERIAL.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the item. To enter or view more information, click the Long Description button.

tositeid.title: Site
tositeid.remarks: Site to which the item is being issued. Click the Select Value button to choose a site.

gldebitacct.title: GL Debit Account
gldebitacct.remarks: GL account being debited when the item is issued. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

issueunit.title: Issue Unit
issueunit.remarks: Standard quantity by which the item is issued from the storeroom, such as each or roll.

invuseid.title: Usage
invuseid.remarks: The inventory usage identifier, which is used to relate an inventory usage line to a completed transaction.

refwo.title: Work Order
refwo.remarks: This field indicates the referenced work order number.

conversion.title: Conversion Factor
conversion.remarks: Numeric value that is applied to relate an order unit to an issue unit. For example, if you order light bulbs in bulk, your unit of measure might be a case, with a quantity received of 36. But when you issue the item, you issue it one at a time. In this case, you can define a measure unit of CASE and another measure unit of EACH. You define a conversion ratio from CASE to EACH with a factor of 36. When you receive an order of this item into a storeroom, MAXIMO converts the received order unit of one CASE into the storeroom's issue unit of 36 EACH.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.remarks: This field indicates the quantity in/out. It is a calculation of items addedand or subtracted.

consvendor.title: Consignment Vendor
consvendor.remarks: The vendor that is responsible for replenishing the consignment items. Purchase orders and invoices are generated for the vendor that is specified in this field.

storeloc.title: Storeroom
storeloc.remarks: The storeroom location of the item. Click Detail menu to choose an option to select a Storeroom. You can edit this field until the work order saved.

transdate.title: Transaction Date
transdate.remarks: Date and time the transaction was entered in Maximo. This field is read only.

mrnum.title: Requisition
mrnum.remarks: Requisition number associated with this transaction. Click the Select Value button to choose a requisition.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Location of the asset or the location where work was done. The work order must have an approved status before you can insert a value; the field can be edited until you save the record. Click Detail menu to choose an option to select a value.
